77314.subject:
How Is Vibe-Code Rescue Powering the Next Chapter of AI
 Development?
77314.body:
Ment Tech | Meant To Innovate

Автор: Ment Tech Labs


Автор: Ment Tech Labs

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/how-vibe-code-rescue-powering-next-chapter-ai-development-xcb4f?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BPTrXKYytQ2GSCMCGf5hi5Q%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=0uAtzCegyckso1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~msoo52yd~7d-null-null&eid=fz96fz-msoo52yd-7d
  
AI changed how software gets built. It hasn't yet changed how software gets kept alive. Recent developer research puts the share of newly written code that is AI-generated between 41% and 46% globally, and it's still climbing fast. Gartner expects vibe coding techniques to power 40% of new enterprise production software by 2028. For founders, product teams, and engineering leaders, that's no longer a side trend. It's the default way products get built now, and it's quietly creating a second industry right behind it. That second industry is vibe-coding rescue. Early adopters treated AI code generation as a shortcut to a working prototype. Describe the idea, let the model write it, and ship it. The results were real. Build costs for a functional product have fallen sharply, and timelines that used to run months now run weeks. But speed came with a trade-off. Prompt-driven builds routinely skip the parts that keep software alive later, including the following: Error handling for edge cases Authentication and access control Automated tests Documentation of what the AI actually built A data model that can scale past a demo None of that shows up in a prototype. All of it shows up the moment a vibe-coded product meets real users, real data, or investors asking hard questions. Reading the System Comes Before Rewriting It The instinct with a broken AI-generated codebase is to throw it out and start over. Most of the time, that's the wrong call. A proper code rescue begins by mapping what the AI actually built: the data flows, the dependencies, the parts that work and the parts that only look like they work. This is where Vibe Code Rescue Services earn their name. The job isn't to judge how a product got built. It's to stabilise it, close the gaps, and hand back something a team can actually maintain. Practitioners increasingly borrow triage language from emergency response to describe the work: a production outage with paying users on it gets treated as a code 3 rescue, pulled ahead of everything else, while a stalled side project waits its turn. If there's one theme across recent audits of AI-generated code, it's security debt. Milý používateľ karty,

* Pri každom prihlasovaní sa do svojho užívateľského online účtu mojedenred.sk budete vyzvaný, aby ste otvorili svoju aplikáciu Edenred pre overenie Vašej identity.

we would like to inform you that we have introduced Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for access to your online user account at www.myedenred.sk ( https://www.myedenred.sk ). The aim is to enhance the protection of your personal data.

👉 What does this mean for you if you do not have the Edenred app installed?

* The login process remains the same as before. You will continue to verify your identity using a security code sent via SMS to the phone number registered in your profile.
